    color = grid[i][j]
    visited = set()
    queue = deque([(i, j)])
    visited.add((i, j))
    
    count = 0
    while queue:
        ni, nj = queue.popleft()

        for di, dj in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
